tests.description: The docs table contract, the DML/DDL vocabulary, collections as views, findings, and the refusal posture.

steps.description: SELECT * returns the four system columns first, then the data columns sorted by name.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config "SELECT * FROM docs" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: A frontmatter key named _path is not lifted to a column; it stays reachable through _data.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config "SELECT _path, _data ->> '$._path' AS shadowed FROM docs" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: A key that is not a bare identifier is an ordinary quoted identifier.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config 'SELECT "sidebar position" AS sp FROM docs WHERE sp IS NOT NULL' test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: _present is 0 for a file with no metadata block at all.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config "SELECT _path FROM docs WHERE _present = 0" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: Each collection is a view of the files its own globs match.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query -c test/fixtures/collections/manni.config.yaml "SELECT _path, slug FROM authors"

steps.description: A file whose own $schema outranks its override is still a member: membership no longer follows resolution.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query -c test/fixtures/collections/manni.config.yaml "SELECT _path FROM authors"

steps.description: Views may overlap: authors/deep.md is matched by the authors collection and by the notes collection, so it is in both.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query -c test/fixtures/collections/manni.config.yaml "SELECT count(*) n FROM notes"

steps.description: A collection view is read-only, and the refusal completes itself with the write-through-docs spelling (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query -c test/fixtures/collections/manni.config.yaml --dry-run "UPDATE authors SET slug = 'x'"

steps.description: SET k = NULL removes the key; the preview says (deleted), not (null).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --dry-run "UPDATE docs SET author = NULL WHERE slug = 'beta'" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: A paired SET renames a key: the deletion and the creation pair up, and the original value is carried over.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --dry-run "UPDATE docs SET byline = author, author = NULL WHERE slug = 'beta'" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: A _path move may not change the extension (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --dry-run "UPDATE docs SET _path = 'test/fixtures/query/docs/beta.txt' WHERE slug = 'beta'" test/fixtures/query/docs
runShell.stdio: a rename may not change the extension

steps.description: explicit_null() is the literal-null spelling SET k = NULL cannot express.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --dry-run "UPDATE docs SET author = explicit_null() WHERE slug = 'beta'" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: DELETE strips the front matter block and names the keys it removes; the file and body survive.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --dry-run "DELETE FROM docs WHERE slug = 'beta'" test/fixtures/query/docs
runShell.stdio: /frontmatter removed: title, slug, author, tags, draft, last_reviewed/

steps.description: A system column other than _path is read-only (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --dry-run "UPDATE docs SET _format = 'x' WHERE slug = 'beta'" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: --check implies the dry run: pending changes are findings, exit 1, files untouched.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --check "UPDATE docs SET reviewed = 'todo' WHERE _present = 1" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: The type bridge: a declared format name previews as the whole property the schema will gain.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --dry-run -c test/fixtures/ddl-bridge/manni.config.yaml "ALTER TABLE docs ADD COLUMN reviewed_on DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT '2026-08-26'" test/fixtures/ddl-bridge/docs

steps.description: A CHECK (k IN (...)) on the added column becomes an enum on the property.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --dry-run -c test/fixtures/ddl-bridge/manni.config.yaml "ALTER TABLE docs ADD COLUMN tier TEXT CHECK (tier IN ('a','b'))" test/fixtures/ddl-bridge/docs

steps.description: A corpus on the built-in default set has no schema of yours to evolve, so DDL refuses and names the data-only spellings (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --dry-run "ALTER TABLE docs ADD COLUMN x TEXT" test/fixtures/query/docs
runShell.stdio: runs on the built-in default set

steps.description: -s names the DDL target set directly, replacing the per-file walk for the planner.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --dry-run -s ./test/fixtures/ddl-bridge/schemas/house.json "ALTER TABLE docs ADD COLUMN reviewed TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'" test/fixtures/ddl-bridge/docs

steps.description: -s on a statement with no schema-evolving effect refuses before anything is applied (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --dry-run -s ./test/fixtures/ddl-bridge/schemas/house.json "SELECT _path FROM docs" test/fixtures/ddl-bridge/docs

steps.description: An unbound named parameter is refused rather than binding NULL into a silently-green gate (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --check "SELECT _path FROM docs WHERE author = :who" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: The column convention in the ad-hoc spelling: path, key, lineFor, and message become a GitHub annotation under check:query.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config --check -f github "SELECT _path AS path, 'slug' AS key, lineFor(_path, 'slug') AS line, 'duplicate slug ' || slug AS message FROM docs WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM docs GROUP BY slug HAVING count(*) > 1)" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: A findings format without --check is refused before the run (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config -f sarif "SELECT _path AS path FROM docs" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: CSV always emits a header row; arrays stay JSON text, RFC 4180 quoted.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config -f csv "SELECT _path, title, tags FROM docs WHERE _present = 1 ORDER BY _path" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: CSV refuses a statement that produced changes, and says nothing was applied (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config -f csv "UPDATE docs SET reviewed = 'todo'" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: ATTACH is refused by name because it can write outside the docs table (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config "ATTACH DATABASE 'x.db' AS y" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: A second statement after a semicolon is refused rather than silently compiled away (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config "SELECT 1; SELECT 2" test/fixtures/query/docs

steps.description: A write cannot touch <stdin>, since there is no file behind it (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --no-config "UPDATE docs SET title = 'X'" - --as markdown < test/fixtures/query/docs/alpha.md
